adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new webhook endpoint (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`) that can update `prisma.credential.key` asynchronously. In the OAuth refresh flows (e.g. `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` and `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`), the code operates on an in-memory snapshot of `credential.key`, mutates/merges token fields, then writes the entire merged object back via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. This read-modify-write pattern can overwrite (clobber) concurrent updates to other parts of `key` that might have been applied by the new webhook sync while the refresh request is in flight, since fields not present in the refresh response are retained from the stale snapshot and persisted back.
